definition: having a lot of money and valuable things
description: A man with a moustache in a brown corduroy jacket and a striped shoulder bag stands at a shop checkout, pulling a blue bank card out of a brown leather wallet next to the card terminal. He then walks through an open-air fruit market and opens the same wallet in front of the fruit crates, searching through it. He lifts the wallet up to the camera with both hands and turns it around so the empty pockets show, grinning in disbelief. Finally he leans over a wooden table where a small pile of loose coins has been tipped out, and pushes the coins around with both hands while another person's hand reaches in from the other side.

taps.phrase: to pull out a bank card
